title: Acute Effects of Dietary Fiber on Blood Glucose and Satiety Considering the Dose–Response Relationship – A Randomized Controlled Intervention Study
summary:
In dieser Studie untersuchen wir, wie sich unterschiedliche Mengen von Chiasamen auf den Blutzucker nach dem Trinken einer Zuckerlösung auswirken. Außerdem möchten wir herausfinden, ob Chiasamen das Sättigungsgefühl und das allgemeine Wohlbefinden beeinflussen. Hintergrund ist, dass Ballaststoffe den Anstieg des Blutzuckers nach einer Mahlzeit verlangsamen können, die optimale Menge jedoch noch nicht klar ist.
Die Teilnehmenden nehmen an vier Testtagen teil und erhalten unterschiedliche Mengen Chiasamen oder keine Chiasamen. Der Blutzucker wird über einen kleinen Sensor am Arm und durch kleine Blutstropfen am Ohrläppchen gemessen. Zusätzlich werden Fragen zum Sättigungsgefühl, Wohlbefinden und möglichen Beschwerden gestellt
conditions: The study investigates the rise in blood glucose following sugar intake and its potential modulation by dietary fiber. Pronounced or repeatedly elevated postprandial blood glucose levels are considered a risk factor for the development of metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes. The aim of the study is to improve the understanding of preventive nutritional strategies and to examine whether different amounts of dietary fiber contribute to stabilizing blood glucose levels.

interventions.name: Intake of water without chia seeds, followed by a standard oral glucose tolerance test (75 g glucose).
Single intake of 10 g chia seeds dissolved in water prior to the oral glucose tolerance test.
Single intake of 30 g chia seeds dissolved in water prior to the oral glucose tolerance test.
Total intake of 30 g chia seeds divided into three portions of 10 g each (one portion prior to the OGTT and two additional portions consumed independently during the day).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Eligible for inclusion are adults (≥ 18 years) in good general health without known metabolic disorders and with a body mass index between 18.5 and 29.9 kg/m². Participants must be willing to attend all scheduled study visits and provide written informed consent after receiving appropriate information about the study. Adequate German language proficiency is required to ensure full understanding of the study information and questionnaires.
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals with known metabolic disorders, particularly diabetes mellitus or impaired glucose tolerance, as well as chronic diseases affecting glucose metabolism or digestion, are excluded from participation. Persons taking medications that influence glucose metabolism, those with known allergies or intolerances to chia seeds or components of the test solutions, pregnant or breastfeeding women, and individuals with acute illnesses at the time of assessment are also excluded from the study.
